name: Earthrealm
description: Home realm of mortal humanity, protected historically by the Thunder God Raiden and now Fire God Liu Kang.

name: Outworld
description: A harsh, majestic imperial realm forged by conquering and merging neighboring worlds.

name: Netherrealm
description: The fiery subterranean plane of eternal torment, demons, revenants, and dark necromancy.

name: Edenia
description: A lush paradise realm of beauty and longevity, merged with Outworld for millennia before its restoration.

name: Orderrealm (Seido)
description: A rigid geometric realm governed strictly by law, hierarchy, and absolute order.

name: Chaosrealm
description: An anarchic realm of shifting structures and freedom where chaos is worshiped as supreme truth.
